cases.name: Sally Ivester
cases.narrative:
She was beaten with a chain and a billy club; struck with a chair leg, and burned with a cigarette lighter in the area of her vagina. A chair leg was forced into her vagina and was then twisted inside and struck with the hand to force it far up into the vaginal area. The billy club was forced into her vagina and ripped the entire portion of her vagina, tearing the wall, causing internal bleeding and such extreme pain, that the shock contributed in great part to the death of the victim, as stated by the medical examiner in his testimony. The beating resulted in 80% of her body being covered with deep bruises, cuts and perforations, in addition to some of her front teeth being broken by blows from the defendant. In addition, the defendant burned her with lit cigarettes on various parts of her body.

cases.name: Stephanie Nicole Ross
cases.about: She was a health care service coordinator for Integra Health Management. Ross was assigned to Smith and about 34 other clients who were on Medicaid. Her job was to visit the clients, complete health assessments and make sure they were completing doctor visits and taking medicines. Her obituary said, "Stephanie loved horses, dogs, and animals of all stripes. She was a 2005 graduate of Lakeland High School and received her Bachelor of Science in psychology from USF in 2012. She planned to pursue a doctorate in psychology in the fall in order to further her work with mental illness and disability. She was dedicated to working with people with special needs and hoped to spread her enthusiasm by teaching others about the complexity and wonders of the human brain."
cases.narrative: She visited his his supported housing unit run by Baycare at 37020 Coleman Ave. to help him manage his Medicaid benefits. Witnesses told police she fled the apartment and ran screaming down the road, with Smith chasing her and slashing at her with a large butcher knife. He chased her and stabbed her multiple times. A passing motorist took her to a local hospital where she died of multiple stab wounds to her upper body.
